english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unusable or an action that is pointless or unhelpful.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person or thing that is of no use or value.
Use this when you want to stress that something is useless or gives no practical benefit.
Use this when something is useless or gives no practical benefit, stronger than merely being unhelpful.
Use this for efforts or actions that are pointless because they will not help or achieve anything.

examples.english: This knife is useless; it can't cut anything.
examples.jyutping: ni1 baa2 dou1 mou5 jung6 cit3 m4 dou2 je5

examples.english: This old umbrella is worthless now, so just throw it away.
examples.traditional: 呢把舊傘已經冇用，掉咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping: ne1 baa2 gau6 saan3 ji5 ging1 mou5 jung6 diu6 zo2 keoi5 laa1

examples.english: This umbrella leaks, so carrying it is ineffective.
examples.traditional: 呢把傘漏水，帶住都冇用。
examples.jyutping: ne1 baa2 saan3 lau6 seoi2 daai2 zyu6 dou1 mou5 jung6

examples.english: This broken umbrella is unhelpful as soon as it rains heavily.
examples.traditional: 呢把爛遮一落大雨就冇用。
examples.jyutping: ni1 baa2 laan6 ze1 jat1 lok6 daai6 jyu5 zau6 mou5 jung6

examples.english: No matter how much you persuade him, he will not change, so continuing to talk is meaningless.
examples.traditional: 你再點勸佢都唔會改，繼續講落去都冇用。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 dim2 hyun3 keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 goi2 gai3 zuk6 gong2 lok6 heoi3 dou1 mou5 jung6
